detail: ANN in T2M_MAX/T2M_MIN is the annual MAX/MIN of the monthly values (not a mean); ANN in T2M/PRECTOTCORR is the mean. ANN is therefore dropped and annual values are recomputed from the 12 monthly values.
31200 rows = 104 grid cells x 25 years x 12 months (expected 31200)
DTR = T2M_MAX - T2M_MIN; monthly rainfall (mm/month) = mm/day x days in month (leap-year aware)
54 of 104 grid cells overlap Bangladesh by >= 20% of cell area; the rest (India/Myanmar/Bay of Bengal) are kept in the master but excluded from analysis
